title: Quantum semantic Reader after optimizer repair: one rescue, inconclusive screen

rating_policy.notes: Active learned selection but exposed Silver and primary CI touches zero; no L1/L2 or quantum-attribution promotion.

hypothesis: Question-conditioned hidden representations improve anchored Top-50 to Top-5 evidence retention.
mechanism: Frozen DPR hidden pooling -> classical projection -> four-qubit interaction -> gated bounded relevance residual.

training_budget.epochs_or_steps: 3 epochs x 434 updates per trained arm
training_budget.selection_rule: same train-only containment cohort, fixed registered 100 x 50 eval panel
training_budget.seed_policy: training 20261008; bootstrap 20261009 plus predeclared comparison offsets

intervention.target: Fixed Top-50 to Top-5; 5000 nonzero corrections and 2 changed quantum sets

statistics.method: 100-question paired bootstrap, 2000 replicates; 1 positive improvement, 99 ties

controls.notes: Exact baseline scores/cohort parity and null verified.
Matched budget/init/optimizer/cohort; active training, no significant difference.
10 changed sets; positive gains/harm cancel. Not parameter matched.

task_utility.notes: Selector Silver diagnostic only; downstream answer utility not run.

robustness.notes: One short run; no independent full-data replication.

attention_alignment.notes: One-question positive/direct rescue; strict-positive paired lower CI fails.

classical_attribution.notes: Matched classical comparison CI [0,0.03] touches zero; no demonstrated quantum advantage.

resource_audit.notes: 15399 parameters each semantic arm, 35 scalar; no quantum advantage or runtime comparison.

next_upgrade.action: Before new implementation, audit train-only supervision and boundary discrimination; keep provisional boundary-focused quantum training exploratory.
next_upgrade.success_gate: Reliable support targets plus selective correction versus compression on train-only validation; separately preregister utility/attribution study.
next_upgrade.kill_criteria: Contract/leakage/numerical failure stops execution; a normal short null remains inconclusive for the broad family.
next_upgrade.estimated_cost: Saved-vector analysis first; deterministic missing train text requires a bounded collaborator-local export, not a full experiment.

limitations: Exposed 100-case Silver and one short seed: L0 only.
Candidate-direction counts are dependent descriptive units, not significance evidence.
